contributions.detail: EVERY cell of the cover's 4x3 grid carries a hand-drawn slashed zero (a circle with a stroke through it). Per the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling a glyph DENOTING zero is 0, so all twelve anchors are 0 with the verbatim glyph recorded here. Form A (page 2) is an entirely EMPTY ruled schedule, which agrees exactly: rows sum 0 = cover line 1. Because all three columns are zero the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide; scope recorded as cumulative.

expenditures.detail: Form B (page 3) is likewise an entirely EMPTY ruled schedule; rows sum 0 = cover line 3, itself a slashed zero in all three columns. Same scope coincidence as the contributions side.

gates.page_subtotal: the Carr 5-5-PG form prints NO schedule total on either schedule (the sheet ends with the '(If additional space is needed...)' note), so the cover's own lines are the only anchors; both are zero and both schedules are empty
gates.row_count: scored by eye against ink at 200 dpi on both schedule pages: ~40 ruled writing lines each, ZERO of them inked. Every mark on pages 2 and 3 is show-through of the page-4 statute text from the reverse of the sheet - it is set in the statute's serif body type, runs edge to edge across the Name/Address/Purpose columns without respecting them, and carries no figure in any Amount cell. rowbands.py not needed: there is no ink to score.
gates.geometry_proof: no rows emitted, so no row geometry to prove
gates.balance_chain: 0 + 0 - 0 = 0 closes exactly; LAST + THIS = CUM holds trivially on all four lines (all cells zero)

escalation_note: none needed - both schedules are empty and every cover cell is an unambiguous slashed zero
